cases.title: GalvanisedSteel in stagnant_water - zinc_depletion_then_substrate_pitting
cases.rationale: Galvanised steel in the stagnant water of a fire main. Zinc depletes with no flow to replenish the passive layer, leaving bare steel. CIBSE Guide G.

cases.title: GalvanisedSteel in hot_water - zinc_polarity_reversal_above_60C
cases.rationale: Galvanised steel in domestic hot water. Above ~60 C zinc reverses polarity against steel and the coating becomes anodic-turned-cathodic. CIBSE Guide G.

cases.title: GalvanisedSteel in pool_water - rapid_zinc_attack_in_chlorinated_water
cases.rationale: Galvanised steel in pool circulation water, the most aggressive cell in the pack. ASTM B117.
Copper in potable cold water, indoors. This is the specification, not a defect. CDA Copper Tube Handbook.

Copper in domestic hot water at the 60 C HSE HSG274 mandates for Legionella control, and that MC-001 requires in this same codebase. Only the pack's kinetics_guard keeps this Low; without it the temperature and environment terms alone would band it Medium.
Copper in chilled water. Benign pairing, benign environment.
PVC in cold water. The plastic is immune to the electrochemical mechanism MM-001 scores, and the pairing is mapped, so the engine scores it and finds nothing.

cases.title: MM-001 not assessed: material not identified on REF-1-material-unknown
cases.rationale: No material identified. The element is unassessed, not compliant.

cases.title: MM-001 not assessed: environment unclassified on REF-2-environment-unclassified
cases.rationale: Environment unclassified, so the environment term cannot be evaluated. Scoring it benign would suppress findings on every element the producer could not classify.

cases.title: MM-001 not assessed: no operating temperature on REF-3-temperature-missing
cases.rationale: No operating temperature. A default here would be a fabricated input to a compliance verdict.

cases.title: MM-001 not assessed: Titanium / oxygen is unmapped
cases.rationale: Titanium in medical oxygen has no cell in the MM-001 matrix. Per unmapped_pairing_policy an absent cell must not be scored compliant.

cases.title: MM-001 not assessed: PVC / foul_water is unmapped
cases.rationale: PVC in foul drainage, with everything else known. The refusal is not about the element: MM-001's matrix carries eight media and foul_water is not one of them, so no material can be scored on a drainage system. Honest, but it bounds what MM-001 can reach -- see the media-coverage limitation in the validation report.
